before: The private adapter had pure canonical edit plans but no live direct executor; only immutable test oracles applied them.
after: applyDirectPlan rechecks every planned old value, previews the complete lowering immutably, and applies it through one gated surface transaction with a separate undo unit. Identity-dependent completions (new-paragraph links and lists, new rows and columns, payload records) run in the existing after-allocation package-edit phase.
reason: Application-owned composition of existing native operations and package-edit hooks. No native operation, shared state, payload schema, or journal format changes. Suggestion mode refuses instead of disabling tracking. Two real sessions verify concurrent peer text, undo/redo, deletion during peer editing, remote caret geometry, and saved convergence. The private package needs no published changeset or public API extraction.
